text: Self-improvement cycle 1: prevent intervention savings from masking worse task completion
description: Observed limitation: the first autonomy benchmark analyzer classified a graph-grounded condition as positive when it used fewer human interventions even though its verified completion rate was worse. Frozen evaluation: the negative-result unit test expected `negative` and failed with actual `positive`. Bounded change: require completion to be non-worse before intervention reduction can establish a positive result. Regression gate: the complete wrapped-agents/common suite and TypeScript type-check must pass. Outcome should be recorded as one of three parent cycles; it does not by itself prove cumulative improvement.

status.comment: Cycle implemented and internally verified; awaiting user acceptance.

valueRationale: This is direct evidence that a test-driven reflection loop can detect and correct an over-optimistic capability claim.
